opening.argument: The speaker presents participation in an arbitrage bot as an opportunity to produce exceptionally rapid returns, stating, "I invested 50 Litecoins, now I've got 40% back in a month." That is not merely a discussion of market risk: he uses his claimed result to support joining the bot and adds urgency by saying, "maybe now is the last chance I would recommend you to join this bot." The combination of investment funding, a 40% monthly return claim, an explicit recommendation, and the suggestion that the opportunity may soon disappear operates as a solicitation. The brief caution to be careful does not change the central message, which encourages both new and existing investors to participate, including through a time-limited bonus.
